name: Loader
title: Loader
description: A cinematic loader with a traveling numeric counter and a smooth staggered curtain reveal.
summary: A large counter glides across a dark canvas, settles at loading milestones, and reaches 100 before vertical panels lift to reveal your content. Use the automatic timeline or provide real loading progress. Tune the duration, panel count, stagger, and colors.
highlights: A responsive counter travels from left to right without clipping
Milestone pauses and coordinated staggered panel motion
Automatic sequence or externally controlled loading progress
Replay and motion controls in the component studio
Scoped GSAP cleanup and reduced-motion support
anatomy: Vertical panels that lift in sequence
Content remains inert until the reveal completes

physics.description: A sequenced GSAP timeline eases the counter through loading milestones, then lifts panels with transform-based motion. External progress updates ease from the current position without restarting the sequence.

accessibility.aria: A named progressbar reports the displayed percentage. A polite status announces content readiness. Covered content is inert and hidden from assistive technology until completion.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Skips counter movement and panel motion. Automatic mode reveals immediately; controlled mode waits for progress to reach 100.

recommended: Real loading flows with measurable progress
bestPractices: Pass actual progress when waiting for assets or data.
Use a new React key to start another loading cycle.
Keep onComplete stable when possible and use children for your own content.
Set the container height with className to suit the layout.

props.name: progress
props.description: Optional actual loading progress, clamped to 0–100. Reaching 100 completes the reveal; omit for the automatic sequence.

props.name: revealDuration
props.description: Duration in seconds for each panel to lift.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay in seconds between adjacent panels.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of reveal panels, clamped to 2–12.

props.name: background
props.description: CSS color of the loading panels.

props.name: className
props.description: Container classes. Set min-height or h-screen for the intended layout.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once after all panels finish revealing. Remount with a new key to replay.
